About
Typefield.

Typefield is a native Mac app for organizing fonts, exploring typography in layouts, and drawing editable letterforms.

Why we made it

From font library to finished type work.

Typefield is an independent Mac app built to make the path from choosing a font to testing it in a layout shorter. It also gives you tools to draw and edit letterforms when the font you want does not exist yet.

Three ways to work.

Each workspace handles a different part of the same creative process.

01

Library

Browse and compare your fonts. Save favorites, collections, tags, and shortlists to find the right face again.

02

Spaces

Try type in editable layouts. Build typeboards, compare directions, and export files for your design or development tools.

03

Letterform Editor

Draw paths or bring in artwork, refine editable outlines and spacing, and export a font you can use.

In public beta.

Typefield is available for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 13 or newer.

Try it with your own fonts.

The beta is a direct download. It does not require a Typefield account or license key. Your library and projects are stored on your Mac, and you choose where to save exports.

See the full feature list for current capabilities, browse the public source, or visit Support if you need help getting started.

Try the beta.

Download Typefield and tell us what works, what feels unclear, or what you would like to see next.
